keyInfo.enterpriseRegenerateTooltip: This is a LiteLLM Enterprise feature, and requires a valid key to use.
keyInfo.deleteAlert: This action is irreversible and will immediately revoke access for any applications using this key.
keyInfo.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this Virtual Key?
keyInfo.resetSpendNote: Current spend: <bold>{spend}</bold>. Spend history is preserved in logs. This resets the current period spend counter, the same as an automatic budget reset
keyInfo.blockNote: Requests using this key will be rejected with a 401 error until it is unblocked. The key is not deleted and can be unblocked at any time
keyInfo.unblockNote: Requests using this key will be accepted again
keyInfo.promptCachingEnabled: Enabled (auto-injects cache_control markers on Anthropic and Bedrock Claude requests)
keyInfo.softBudgetInvalid: Soft Budget must be a finite number
keyInfo.mcpUnavailable: MCP server or toolset list is unavailable, so MCP permissions cannot be saved yet. Retry.

keysEdit.modelsDisabledForType: Models field is disabled for this key type
keysEdit.allowedRoutesHint: List of allowed routes for the key (comma-separated). Can be specific routes (e.g., '/chat/completions') or route patterns (e.g., 'llm_api_routes', 'management_routes', '/keys/*'). Leave empty to allow all routes.
keysEdit.allowedRoutesPlaceholder: Enter allowed routes (comma-separated). Special values: llm_api_routes, management_routes. Examples: llm_api_routes, /chat/completions, /keys/*. Leave empty to allow all routes
keysEdit.softBudgetPlaceholder: Get alerts when spend crosses this value, without blocking requests
keysEdit.budgetWindowsHint: Set multiple independent budget windows (e.g., hourly 10,000 tokens AND monthly 200,000 tokens). Each window tracks spend separately and resets on its own schedule.
keysEdit.budgetFallbacksHint: When a model exceeds its per-model budget, requests automatically reroute to fallback models instead of failing
keysEdit.throttleHint: When this key exceeds its max budget, throttle its TPM/RPM to the globally configured percentage instead of blocking access entirely. Requires budget_exceeded_throttle_percentage in litellm_settings and a TPM/RPM limit on the key.
keysEdit.promptCachingHint: Automatically add prompt caching breakpoints (cache_control markers) to requests made with this key, cutting input cost on repeated prompts. Applies to Anthropic and Bedrock Claude models; requests that already set their own cache_control markers are left untouched.
keysEdit.perTagRateLimitsHint: Scope rate limits to a request tag so each tag (e.g. a cell or group) gets its own RPM counter. Requests without a matching tag fall back to the key-level limit.
keysEdit.disableGlobalGuardrailsHint: When enabled, this key will bypass any guardrails configured to run on every request (global guardrails)
keysEdit.policiesHint: Apply policies to this key to control guardrails and other settings
keysEdit.promptsPremiumHint: Setting prompts by key is a premium feature
keysEdit.promptsPremiumPlaceholder: Premium feature - Upgrade to set prompts by key
keysEdit.accessGroupsHint: Assign access groups to this key. Access groups control which models, MCP servers, and agents this key can use
keysEdit.passThroughPremiumHint: Setting allowed pass through routes by key is a premium feature
keysEdit.passThroughPremiumPlaceholder: Premium feature - Upgrade to set allowed pass through routes by key
keysEdit.passThroughPlaceholder: Select or enter allowed pass through routes
keysEdit.mcpServersPlaceholder: Select MCP servers or access groups (optional)
keysEdit.organizationHint: The organization this key belongs to. Selecting an organization filters the available teams.
keysEdit.organizationLocked: Organization is locked because this key belongs to a project
keysEdit.teamLocked: Team is locked because this key belongs to a project
